captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a torque-tube rear axle assembly. It features a long, dark-colored tubular torque tube enclosing the internal propshaft, which connects to a central banjo-type differential housing. Extending laterally from this differential housing are two axle tubes terminating in grey, circular wheel hubs. The two outer wheel hubs are designed to spin independently on revolute joints located at the flange faces of the differential housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a torque-tube rear axle assembly using CadQuery. The model should include a central banjo-style differential housing, a long perpendicular torque tube, and two lateral axle shafts. Mount two spin-capable grey wheel hubs on revolute joints at the ends of the axle shafts.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed by first creating a central differential housing using a combination of spheres and cylinders. The perpendicular torque tube is built using nested cylindrical sweeps and extrusions, capped with a front flange. Lateral axle tubes are extruded symmetrically from the differential housing. Finally, two distinct wheel hub components are modeled as stepped cylinders with bolt-circle patterns, and are attached to the axle ends using revolute joints.
